verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's plan/apply workflow (speculative plans, plan files, -out for review before apply) gives a foundation for gated approval workflows, and state encryption adds credential/data protection, but there is no evidence of agent-specific least-privilege credential scoping, policy-as-code enforcement (e.g. Sentinel/OPA equivalent), or built-in approval/review gate mechanisms tailored to AI agents. missing for 10: agent-specific least-privilege credential issuance, native policy-as-code/OPA-style enforcement blocking unapproved changes, built-in human-in-the-loop approval gates, and any AI-agent integration documentation.
